data.body: Audit result (task d299): grep for cycle_count|CYCLE_COUNT in plugins/dso/scripts/ and .claude/scripts/ (*.sh files) returned one match: plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/approach-cycle-state.sh. This script tracks the /dso:implementation-plan approach-resolution loop cycle count (counter-proposal revision iterations per story), not review iteration counts. It is a separate concern from DD7. grep for review_cycle|replan_cycle_count returned zero results. DD7 satisfied: no inline shell cycle counter for review cycles exists. The DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE env var in runner.py is a Python CI runner mechanism (out of scope). The approach-cycle-state.sh counter is out of scope for this audit (it does not track review cycles and is not a substitute for cycle-ledger.json).
